title: analysis.hunk.diff.export request
description: Compare two HUNK executables exactly as `analysis.hunk.diff` does, then write that comparison as a report. `prepared_output`: accepts only `prepare` and `commit_reviewed`.

a.description: The first image, reported as the `a` side.

b.description: The second image, reported as the `b` side.

maximum_changed_ranges.description: Cap on the changed ranges reported per hunk. The true count is always reported, so a capped comparison can never be read as a complete one.

destination.description: Directory the report goes in, as an identity the adapter resolves against its own output root. Relative, normal components only.

file_name.description: File name within the destination: one relative path component, so an export cannot write beside its destination let alone outside it. Defaults to `hunk-diff.json` or `hunk-diff.txt`, by format.

format.description: `json` is the structured report another program reads; `text` is the rendered one a person reads. Both describe the same comparison.
